responsibility: Implements GCC’s timing-variable engine used for -ftime-report and related performance accounting. It gathers user, system, wall-clock, and GGC-memory measurements from the host timing facilities, maintains the timer stack and per-timevar accumulators generated from timevar.def, supports nested parent/child attribution and JIT client-defined named timing items, updates totals as phases are pushed and popped, validates aggregate timing consistency, and formats the final timing report and helper diagnostics showing time and memory consumed by compiler phases.
same_name_distinction: This is the runtime implementation in the timevar group: it measures host user/system/wall time and GGC memory, maintains timer stacks and accumulators, supports named client timing items, validates totals, and prints reports. Unlike timevar.def, which only lists timing-variable IDs/names, and timevar.h, which declares the enum, data structures, and public API/RAII wrappers, this file contains the timing engine itself.
